name: Praseodymium calcium manganite
equilibrium_context: Charge- and orbitally ordered insulator below about 230 K, canted antiferromagnet; no metal in equilibrium at ambient pressure and zero field
summary: Two states with opposite excitation channels: one via photocarriers with a bias field, the other via resonant excitation of a single lattice vibration without any electronic excitation.

driven_states.emergent_property: Photocarrier injection causes the charge-ordered insulator to collapse; the resulting state is ferromagnetic and metallic. The photocurrent is highly non-linear in both field and light intensity, with threshold behavior in both.

threshold.quantity: light intensity and bias field, both with a threshold

driven_states.source: Miyano, Tanaka, Tomioka & Tokura, Phys. Rev. Lett. 78, 4257 (1997), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.78.4257
further_sources: Fiebig et al., Science 280, 1925 (1998), doi:10.1126/science.280.5371.1925 (spatially resolved visualization)
Polli, Rini, Wall, Schoenlein, Tomioka, Tokura, Cerullo & Cavalleri, Nature Materials 6, 643 (2007), doi:10.1038/nmat1979 (coherent orbital waves)
driven_states.caveat: Miyano et al. explicitly rule out laser heating, via the dependence on photon energy and temperature, which contradicts a heating model - one of the cleanest non-thermal arguments in the field. However: the effect requires an applied bias field and is therefore, strictly speaking, photo-assisted field-driven. Without a field the state does not appear. In addition, phase coexistence acts as an amplifier - the transition is in part a percolation threshold, not a homogeneous Mott collapse.

driven_states.emergent_property: Resonant excitation of a single lattice vibration (Mn-O stretching mode at 17 micrometers), without any electronic excitation across the gap, drives the crystal from the stable insulating into a metastable metallic phase. Prototype of non-linear phononics.
further_sources: Foerst et al., Nature Physics 7, 854 (2011), doi:10.1038/nphys2055 (non-linear phononics as a control mechanism)
driven_states.caveat: Non-thermal in the excitation channel, since 73 meV lies far below the gap and no charge carriers are created. But the mode heats the lattice subsystem locally and anharmonically. Non-thermal here means: no equilibrium heating. It does NOT mean purely electronic.

sources: Miyano et al., Phys. Rev. Lett. 78, 4257 (1997), doi:10.1103/PhysRevLett.78.4257
gaps: Threshold values in both cases not verified against the full text.
The photon energy of the cw case is reported as a range from 1.5 to 2.5 eV; the midpoint is entered here.
